semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Tochigi Prefecture Government supports semiconductor industry growth through regional development and collaboration with local companies.
summary: Tochigi Prefecture Government focuses on enhancing the semiconductor industry within its region by promoting local manufacturing capabilities and supporting semiconductor-related companies. The prefecture showcases its industrial parks and the ability to handle various difficult-to-machine materials, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Integrated production from processing to painting
Handling of difficult-to-machine materials including aluminum, ceramics, and titanium
In-house composite mounting using wire bonding and soldering
Production of components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment

regional_presence.Japan: Tochigi Prefecture is recognized as a leading manufacturing region in Japan, particularly for the semiconductor industry.
